# Hwheat Penny

A wheat penny, pronounced with the h. One penny, one rotation, counted every
time it rolled on its way here.

- `/` — the hwheat penny: the economics, the roll count, the tools.
- `/isotopes/cornichon` (hash route) — the live penny: the live mirror count, the
  last prompt priced, rotations made in memory, and the agent prompt.
- `/skill` (hash route) — recalculate-hweat-penny: the search plan that tells an
  agent which tools to find and how to re-derive every number. Served raw at
  `skill.md`.
- `/guide` (hash route) — the mistake: the 32-line string-mapper, priced, and the
  one-rule CSS fix.
- `/pitch` (hash route) — a security trade-off is not a flag: the register, the
  two currencies, and the penny.

The numbers on the page were read at build time from `scripts/lab/rotation.py`,
`scripts/lab/cost.py`, `scripts/lab/penny.py`, `GET /status` on the mirror, and
`opencode.db` in the `kb` vault — not invented.

## Invariants

- No navigation list: one route plus four hash routes.
- No analytics, no search index, no CMS: React + Vite + Tailwind v4 + fancy-ui,
  served statically from GitHub Pages.
- The voice is one rule (prepend "h" to a "w" word); both spellings render and
  CSS picks one via `html[data-voice]`. The "h" is deliberate. There is a toggle.

## Build and verify

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
```
